parameters.name: AlarmDetail
parameters.description: The risks that you want to detect by using the rule.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

> This parameter is deprecated.

parameters.name: ClusterName
parameters.description:
The cluster name.

> This parameter is deprecated.

parameters.name: MaliciousImage
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the rule supports malicious Internet images. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

parameters.name: RuleAction
parameters.description:
The action that is performed when the rule is hit. Valid values:

*   **1**: trigger alerts
*   **2**: block
*   **3**: allow

parameters.name: Scopes
parameters.description: The application scope of the rule.

parameters.name: StrategyId
parameters.description:
The rule ID.

>  You can call the [ListOpaClusterStrategyNew](~~2623574~~) operation to query the rule ID.

> This parameter is invalid when you create a rule.

parameters.name: StrategyTemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the rule template.

>  You can call the [GetOpaStrategyTemplateSummary](~~2539952~~) operation to query the ID of the rule template.

parameters.name: UnScanedImage
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the rule supports unscanned images. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**
